nodes.name: enemy-ship.glb
nodes.summary: 3D GLB model asset for the enemy spacecraft, loaded at runtime via useGLTF and cloned per enemy instance in Enemies.tsx.

nodes.name: low-poly-asteroid.glb
nodes.summary: Low-polygon 3D GLB model asset for asteroids, used as the shared geometry source for instanced mesh rendering in Asteroids.tsx.

nodes.name: mine.glb
nodes.summary: 3D GLB model asset for space mines, loaded and cloned per mine instance in Mines.tsx with a slow rotation animation.

nodes.name: sun.glb
nodes.summary: 3D GLB model asset for the in-scene sun object, loaded in Sun.tsx and re-materialised with a MeshBasicMaterial to achieve a self-lit appearance.

nodes.name: Asteroids.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber component that spawns an instanced mesh field of low-poly asteroids, handles per-frame rotation animation, detects player and enemy collisions, and renders procedural explosion effects on destruction.

nodes.name: AsteroidExplosion
nodes.summary: Local React component that animates a procedural shader-based explosion sphere over ~1.4 seconds then unmounts itself.

nodes.name: Asteroids
nodes.summary: Exported component managing the asteroid field: initialises store data, updates the instanced mesh transform per frame, checks player and enemy collision, and spawns AsteroidExplosion components for destroyed asteroids.

nodes.name: FlightScene.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level React Three Fiber scene composition component for the flight mode, assembling lighting, starfield, player ship, enemies, lasers, mines, asteroids, sun, and mission waypoints into a single renderable group.

nodes.name: FlightScene
nodes.summary: Exported root scene component that wires together all flight-mode sub-components under configurable ambient and hemisphere lighting with optional debug light helpers controlled via the debug store.

nodes.name: Lasers.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber component rendering player and enemy laser bolts as instanced cylinder meshes with custom animated shader materials, updated each frame from the combat store.

nodes.name: Lasers
nodes.summary: Exported component managing two instanced meshes (player cyan and enemy red) for laser bolts, advancing physics via the combat store each frame and orientating each bolt along its velocity vector.

nodes.name: Mines.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber component that spawns a randomised field of space mines loaded from a GLB model, handles player and enemy collision detonation, and displays explosion VFX for destroyed mines.

nodes.name: Mine
nodes.summary: Local component rendering a single rotating mine model, detecting proximity-based detonation against the player camera and active enemies each frame.

nodes.name: Mines
nodes.summary: Exported component that initialises the mine field in the combat store, tracks detonated mines, and renders active Mine components alongside MineExplosion effects.

nodes.name: Sun.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber component rendering the in-scene sun from a GLB model with a converted MeshBasicMaterial for self-illumination, a slow rotation animation, and an attached directional light with Leva-controlled position and intensity.

nodes.name: Sun
nodes.summary: Exported component that loads and re-materialises the sun GLB, applies Leva-driven position and scale controls, slowly rotates the mesh each frame, and emits a configurable directional light.

nodes.name: shaders.ts
nodes.summary: GLSL shader source strings and THREE.ShaderMaterial factory functions for three visual effects: engine plasma glow, laser bolt bolts, and procedural explosion fire used throughout the flight scene.

nodes.name: makeEngineGlowMaterial
nodes.summary: Factory that creates a transparent additive ShaderMaterial for animated engine plasma, parameterised by core and flame hex colours.

nodes.name: makeLaserMaterial
nodes.summary: Factory that creates a transparent additive ShaderMaterial for instanced laser bolt rendering, parameterised by a single hex colour.

nodes.name: makeExplosionMaterial
nodes.summary: Factory that creates a double-sided transparent ShaderMaterial for procedural explosion fire with displacement, heat-colour ramp, and progress-driven fade.

nodes.name: LCDPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Presentational UI component that wraps content in a styled LCD-style panel container used across game interface screens.

nodes.name: LCDPanel
nodes.summary: Exported React component rendering a styled LCD panel wrapper with optional className and style props.

nodes.name: ScanlineOverlay.tsx
nodes.summary: Presentational UI component rendering a CSS scanline overlay effect to give the game interface a retro CRT aesthetic.

nodes.name: ScanlineOverlay
nodes.summary: Exported React component that renders a full-screen scanline div overlay for CRT visual effect.

nodes.name: TerminalText.tsx
nodes.summary: Animated text component that progressively reveals characters at a configurable delay to simulate a terminal typewriter effect.

nodes.name: TerminalText
nodes.summary: Exported React component that uses useState and setInterval to progressively reveal text characters, simulating a terminal typewriter animation.

nodes.name: DebugPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Developer debug panel providing an in-game Leva controls GUI for remapping key bindings and toggling debug visualization overlays such as direction helpers, camera info, stats, and light helpers.

nodes.name: ControlsConfig
nodes.summary: Internal React component that renders Leva GUI controls for each configurable key binding, calling setBinding on user interaction.

nodes.name: DebugControls
nodes.summary: Internal React component using Leva controls to expose boolean toggles for debug visualizations stored in useDebugStore.

nodes.name: DebugPanel
nodes.summary: Exported panel component that mounts the Leva debug GUI on a keyboard shortcut (backtick key) and renders ControlsConfig and DebugControls sub-components.

nodes.name: useControlsConfig.ts
nodes.summary: Custom React hook and default bindings configuration for player input key mappings, providing a Zustand-backed store for reading and updating control bindings.

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: Application entry point that mounts the React root into the DOM and imports global CSS styles.

nodes.name: audio.ts
nodes.summary: Web Audio API utility module providing procedurally generated sound effects for laser fire and explosions using oscillators and gain envelopes.

nodes.name: initAudio
nodes.summary: Exported function that initializes the shared AudioContext and resumes it to satisfy browser autoplay policies.

nodes.name: playLaserSound
nodes.summary: Exported function that synthesizes a descending-frequency laser sound using an oscillator with exponential frequency and gain ramps via the Web Audio API.

nodes.name: playExplosionSound
nodes.summary: Exported function that synthesizes an explosion sound using a low-frequency oscillator with gain decay envelope via the Web Audio API.

nodes.name: player-ship.glb
nodes.summary: Binary GLTF 3D model asset for the player ship, loaded via useGLTF in launch and landing transition scenes.

nodes.name: GameCanvas.tsx
nodes.summary: Root React Three Fiber Canvas component that hosts a SceneManager routing to game mode scenes and a DebugOverlays layer for stats and gizmos.

nodes.name: SceneManager
nodes.summary: Internal React component that reads currentMode from useGameStore and renders the matching scene component via a switch statement.

nodes.name: DebugOverlays
nodes.summary: Internal React component that conditionally renders drei Stats and GizmoViewport overlays based on useDebugStore flags.

nodes.name: GameCanvas
nodes.summary: Exported root component that creates the R3F Canvas with device pixel ratio and camera defaults, mounting SceneManager and DebugOverlays.

nodes.name: useDebugStore.ts
nodes.summary: Zustand store managing boolean debug overlay flags (stats, directions, camera info, light helpers) with individual setter actions.

nodes.name: BarScene.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber scene composing a space-bar environment with animated table, Leva-controlled lighting, and optional debug light helpers.

nodes.name: BarScene
nodes.summary: Exported R3F scene component rendering the bar environment with Leva-driven ambient and point light controls, animated floating table, and conditional debug geometry.

nodes.name: BriefingScene.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber scene for the mission briefing room with a rotating holographic globe and moody blue-tone lighting.

nodes.name: BriefingScene
nodes.summary: Exported R3F scene component rendering a briefing table with a spinning wireframe hologram map and cyan point light.

nodes.name: LandingScene.tsx
nodes.summary: Transition scene animating the player ship decelerating through a lit landing tube, then triggering mission completion and BAR mode on arrival.

nodes.name: LandingScene
nodes.summary: Exported R3F scene that animates the ship along a landing tube, follows with camera shake, calls completeMission and transitions to BAR when z reaches zero.

nodes.name: LaunchScene.tsx
nodes.summary: Transition scene accelerating the player ship through a glowing launch tube, triggering FLIGHT mode once the ship clears the tube.

nodes.name: LaunchScene
nodes.summary: Exported R3F scene that accelerates the cloned player ship model down a torus-ringed tube with camera shake, then sets game mode to FLIGHT.

nodes.name: QuartersScene.tsx
nodes.summary: Static React Three Fiber scene representing the player's personal quarters with a bed, wall, and picture frame composed of basic geometry.

nodes.name: QuartersScene
nodes.summary: Exported R3F scene component rendering a minimal sleeping quarters room using box, plane, and ambient/directional lights.

nodes.name: useGameStore.ts
nodes.summary: Central Zustand game state store managing game mode, player health with shield/hull damage model, kill/credit stats, mission lifecycle, and boundary warning state.

nodes.name: useMissionStore.ts
nodes.summary: Zustand singleton managing mission lifecycle (start, update objectives, complete, fail) and arcade score/level tracking, seeded with three hard-coded missions on initialisation.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite HTML entry point that mounts the React application, sets the page title and favicon, and loads the TypeScript module entry point src/main.tsx.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM package manifest defining the void-commander project dependencies (React 18, Three.js, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, Zustand, Leva) and scripts for dev, build, and preview via Vite.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript configuration for the browser bundle, setting strict mode, JSX preserve for Vite processing, and targeting ESNext with bundler module resolution.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for Node.js tooling (Vite config file), using CommonJS module resolution and targeting ESNext.

nodes.name: .gitattributes
nodes.summary: Configures Git LFS tracking for `.glb` binary 3D model files, ensuring they are stored via Large File Storage rather than directly in the repository.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Template ignore file for the understand-anything analysis tool, listing commented-out glob patterns that can be uncommented to exclude files or directories from codebase scanning.

nodes.name: flight.css
nodes.summary: Styles for in-flight HUD elements and UI overlays, including enemy and waypoint label variants, boundary-warning banners with pulse and flash keyframe animations, and a debug camera info panel.

nodes.name: Starfield.tsx
nodes.summary: React Three Fiber component that procedurally generates 5000 stars distributed across a large sphere using spherical coordinates, with per-star color variation (white, blue, and orange) and randomized brightness, memoized for performance.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `useMemo` with an empty dependency array to generate the star geometry once on mount, avoiding per-frame recomputation of 5000 THREE.Color allocations.

nodes.name: Starfield
nodes.summary: Exported React Three Fiber component that builds a points-based star field geometry, distributing stars uniformly on a sphere via spherical-to-Cartesian conversion and rendering them as colored point sprites.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet establishing the game's dark sci-fi visual theme: CSS custom properties for neon colors and backgrounds, body/root full-viewport layout, CRT scanline and vignette overlay effects, `.lcd-panel` card component, terminal typography, and an `.interactive-btn` with animated hover sweep.

nodes.name: vite-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript ambient declaration file that references Vite client types and declares a module augmentation for `*.glb` files, allowing 3D model assets to be imported as URL strings without type errors.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration that registers the React plugin for JSX/TSX transformation and adds `**/*.glb` to `assetsInclude` so Three.js GLB model files are handled as static assets with URL imports.
